Wider Sports News.title: Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge marks historic milestone to crown FIA World Rally-Raid champions: FIA
Wider Sports News.summary: Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge marks historic milestone to crown FIA World Rally-Raid champions: FIA برق الإمارات
bullets: The 35th Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge will host the final round of the FIA World Rally-Raid Championship for the first time, from 22 to 27 November, with the drivers', co-drivers' and manufacturers' champions to be decided. The event is organised by the Emirates Motorsports Organisation and starts and finishes in Al Ain. FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem, who founded the event in 1991, said hosting the finale highlights the UAE's global motorsport standing.

Toyota Gazoo Racing's Seth Quintero leads the drivers' standings on 135 points, 14 ahead of Sébastien Loeb on 121, with Nasser Al-Attiyah third on 115. Thirty points are available for the overall win. Dacia Sandriders lead the manufacturers' standings on 372, 47 clear of Toyota Gazoo Racing on 325, with Ford Racing third on 232. Andrew Short leads the navigators' standings on 135.
Wider Sports News.copy:
FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem said the 35th edition of the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge reaches another significant milestone in its history later this month. The event will host the final round of the FIA World Rally-Raid Championship for the first time when it takes place from 22nd to 27th November, with the drivers, manufacturers and co-drivers’ champions to be decided.

Ben Sulayem, who founded the event in 1991, said it has now established itself as one of the world’s most enduring and technically demanding rally-raid events, and one which continues to grow. He said hosting the final round highlights the UAE’s global motorsport standing.

Wider Sports News.title: Sid Lee Sport partners with Guinness to measure the true commercial value of sports sponsorship
Wider Sports News.summary: Sid Lee Sport partners with Guinness to measure the true commercial value of sports sponsorship European Sponsorship Association
bullets: Sid Lee Sport, working with sister agency Kepler, is evaluating Guinness's global sports sponsorship portfolio to assess the commercial impact of its football and rugby partnerships. The project covers six markets (Great Britain, Ireland, Kenya, the United States, Indonesia and South Korea) and nine rights holders. These include the Premier League, Arsenal, Aston Villa, Newcastle United and the Guinness Men's and Women's Six Nations.

The evaluation uses KIP, a proprietary platform, to analyse three years of sales, brand and partnership data and isolate the incremental commercial impact of the investments. It looks beyond exposure at broadcast media value, digital reach, stadium pouring rights, fan research and experiential activation. Sid Lee Sport's Mike Grumbridge said the industry relies heavily on traditional metrics such as media exposure and reach. The findings are intended to inform future investment decisions.
Wider Sports News.copy:
Major evaluation project spans six markets and nine rights holders, moving beyond traditional media valuation to assess the business impact of Guinness’s global sponsorship portfolio.

Global sports marketing agency Sid Lee Sport, working alongside sister agency, Kepler, is undertaking a major evaluation of Guinness’s global sports sponsorship portfolio, designed to establish a clearer understanding of the commercial impact of its football and rugby partnerships.

bullets: The 2026-27 season is the first in which Premier League clubs cannot carry gambling sponsors on the front of their shirts. Bally's and Betano were replaced by technology, tourism and financial services firms, while Stake moved to shirt sleeves. A University of Bristol analysis found the ban removed about 10% of gambling messages on the opening weekend. Roughly half of that was offset by more exposure on sleeves, training kits and LED pitch-side screens.

Half the league needed new front-of-shirt sponsors: Bournemouth moved Vitality from stadium to shirt, Brentford added Indeed and Nottingham Forest signed Marex. Chelsea signed crypto firm Circle after starting the season with a blank shirt. Ampere Analytics estimates that the eight clubs needing new sponsors saw combined annual deal value rise from £67 million to £75 million. Clubs in the three divisions below remain free to sign gambling deals, and Betano will sponsor Euro 2028.

The aircraft made its first flight, from Abu Dhabi to Madrid, on 10 November. It will operate routes including Dublin, Milan, Vienna, Bali, Bangkok and Delhi.

Jamie Wood, Etihad's head of partnerships, said the airline is targeting new audiences and positioning itself as premium. He named India, where Etihad serves 11 cities, as a priority market. Co-branded Etihad and McLaren loungewear is being rolled out to premium cabins on long-haul flights until after the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix in December. Wood said plans for 2027 are tied to key growth markets. Etihad has been tied to the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix since 2009.
Formula 1 & Motorsport.copy:

Etihad has decided rules are for budget carriers and instead painted an entire Boeing 787 Dreamliner in McLaren colours, making it the first time a Formula 1 team has ever appeared on a wide-body aircraft. Not since Pepsi talked Air France into painting a Concorde blue back in 1996 has a paint job looked this quick.

Formula 1 & Motorsport.summary: Mark Walter Exploring Cadillac F1 Sale: Could Dodgers Be Next? DodgersBeat
bullets: Mark Walter is reportedly shopping his Cadillac Formula 1 team with an asking price of at least $3 billion, according to Sportico's Kurt Badenhausen. At least seven parties are said to be interested. In late August, Walter's company TWG Global had dismissed the possibility of selling its stake in the team or any other part of TWG Motorsports.

Walter reportedly faces a repayment deadline of roughly $20 billion by the end of the year. The FBI and the US Securities and Exchange Commission are conducting parallel investigations into alleged tax fraud involving insurance companies connected to TWG Global. He has already sold his stakes in the Los Angeles Lakers and Chelsea, and is also exploring a sale of the Los Angeles Sparks. The Dodgers say it remains business as usual.
Formula 1 & Motorsport.copy:
LOS ANGELES, CA—While the pre-season MLB lockout will take center stage in the conversation around the sport this winter, fans of the Los Angeles Dodgers should pay more attention to the federal investigation into controlling owner Mark Walter.

While Walter made his first public comments in late October, saying that despite the investigation he has no intention of selling the Dodgers, that has now become increasingly likely, especially after the most recent rumors surrounding him.

Formula 1 & Motorsport.title: How Istanbul is revamping its F1 circuit to clinch long-term future
Formula 1 & Motorsport.summary: How Istanbul is revamping its F1 circuit to clinch long-term future Motorsport.com
bullets: Istanbul Park will return to the F1 calendar next year under a new five-year contract, with the circuit layout, including the well-known Turn 8, remaining unchanged. Turkish Automobile Federation (TOSFED) president Eren Uclertopragi said the event will be overhauled, with more covered grandstands, fan zones, improved hospitality and better traffic flow and crowd management.

TOSFED is now both the national motorsport federation and the promoter, after the circuit was previously run by a private company. Uclertopragi said that company's priorities were not the sport, the fans or Formula 1. The paddock is being expanded, with capacity doubled and infrastructure rebuilt from scratch. The asphalt, which drivers described as like "driving on ice" in 2020, also needs to be in better condition. He credited FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem with helping secure the return.
Formula 1 & Motorsport.copy:
Istanbul Park will return to the F1 calendar next year. Beloved by drivers, the layout will remain intact, but when it comes to the event itself, the organisers want to learn from the past and give it a substantial overhaul

Finding the right balance is often a challenge in modern Formula 1. That applies to the technical regulations: striking a balance between satisfying drivers and purists on the one hand, and delivering the spectacle F1 wants to offer younger fans on the other, with a constant stream of overtaking moves for, let’s say, the TikTok generation.

The 73rd Macau Grand Prix is set to feature a record number of drivers from Formula 1 junior academies, underlining the event’s standing as a proving ground for the sport’s future talent.

Across the FIA Formula Regional World Cup and the FIA Formula 4 World Cup, 15 academy drivers from seven F1 teams’ junior programmes will take part. Formula 1 & Motorsport.copy:
After claiming the F1 Academy title, Alisha Palmowski has already confirmed her plans for next season, as she continues her journey in motorsport. Palmowski enjoyed one of the most successful campaigns in F1 Academy history. The Briton, who debuted in the penultimate round of the 2024 season, joined Campos and Red Bull Racing for her two-year stint in the series.

Across this season, the 20-year-old has claimed a podium in every round so far this season, the latest leaving her champion in Austin, with three races to spare. Her sublime form in F1 Academy drew many eyes, but none more than Red Bull Racing. Ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the Milton Keynes squad announced that Palmowski would officially join its junior team programme, helping continue her journey throughout the feeder series ladder.

Cycling.title: No room for Pogačar Tour de France win in UCI Awards, Gillespie makes it
Cycling.summary: No room for Pogačar Tour de France win in UCI Awards, Gillespie makes it Sticky Bottle
bullets: The UCI's 2026 Fan Vote Awards shortlists give Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) just one nomination, for 'feat of the year' after winning Milan-Sanremo. His record-equalling fifth Tour de France win, with five stage victories, is not listed, and he is absent from the 'climber of the year' category. Lara Gillespie (UAE Team L'IMAD), the Irish road race champion, is one of 10 riders nominated for 'sprinter of the year'.

The awards have five categories: feat, domestic, young rider, climber and sprinter of the year. Each category mixes men and women, and the five winners are chosen by fan vote. They will be presented at the UCI annual gala in Benidorm on 9 December. UCI president David Lappartient said riders write the season's story, but it resonates most with fans, and the Fans' Choice Awards will show which moments meant the most to the public.
Cycling.copy:
Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) may have won a record-equalling fifth Tour de France, claiming five stage wins along the way, but there is no place for his Tour performance in the achievements of year selected by the UCI.

While the Slovenian does get one nomination in the UCI's annual awards, while others get three, it is for winning Milan-Sanremo. His Tour ride does not even merit a nomination for 'climber of the year' and is instead completely overlooked.

Cycling.title: Reports suggest XDS may withdraw sponsorship of the XDS-Astana team before the scheduled 2029 date
Cycling.summary: Reports suggest XDS may withdraw sponsorship of the XDS-Astana team before the scheduled 2029 date Cyclingnews
Cycling.copy:
Reports in the French sports paper L'Equipe have emerged questioning the future of bike manufacturer XDS as a name sponsor of the XDS-Astana team. Escaping what was, at one stage, almost certain relegation from the WorldTour at the end of 2025, the Kazakh squad have been one of the revelations of the men’s peloton in the last two years since the Chinese bike manufacturer came on board.

In 2025, XDS’s first year as a title sponsor, the team cleverly targeted UCI points at races all over the World, closing the year as the fourth-ranked team and escaping the drop to ProTeam level. While they slipped to sixth place in 2026, they still finished ahead of the vast bulk of WorldTour teams, with Netcompany-Ineos and Soudal-QuickStep among the outfits trailing in their wake.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.title: Fourth edition of Qatar-UAE Super Cup to take place in December | Gulf Times
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Fourth edition of Qatar-UAE Super Cup to take place in December | Gulf Times Gulf Times
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
The Organising Committee for the Qatar-UAE Super Cup has announced that the fourth edition of the tournament will take place in both countries from December 17 to 20, featuring eight clubs, with four teams representing each country, competing in four matches for four titles.

The tournament will kick off on December 17 at 7pm, with the Challenge Shield match, which will see Qatar’s Al Shamal SC, runners-up of the Qatar Stars League (QSL), face UAE’s Shabab Al Ahli, runners-up of the ADNOC Pro League, at Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.title: Al Wasl beat Al Nasr 2–0 in ADIB Cup derby
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Al Wasl beat Al Nasr 2–0 in ADIB Cup derby Sharjah24
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Sharjah24: Al Wasl strengthened their lead at the top of the Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank Cup (ADIB Cup) standings with a 2–0 derby win over Al Nasr at Zabeel Stadium in the standout fixture of the fourth round. The result took Al Wasl to 12 points, while Al Nasr remained on seven.

Renato Júnior opened the scoring for Al Wasl in the 34th minute, and Brayan Palacios doubled their lead in the 40th minute. It was Al Wasl’s fourth win in the competition, taking them to 12 points, while Al Nasr stayed on seven.

UAE Pro League & GCC Football.title: Al Ain claim first ADIB Cup win of the season
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.summary: Al Ain claim first ADIB Cup win of the season Sharjah24
UAE Pro League & GCC Football.copy:
Sharjah24: Al Ain beat hosts Hatta 1–0 at Hamdan bin Rashid Al Maktoum Stadium today in the fourth round of the Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank Cup (ADIB Cup), taking their tally to four points while Hatta remained on one.

Abdul Karim Traoré scored the only goal with a powerful header in the 72nd minute. Al Ain’s first win in the competition this season moved them up to eighth place with four points, while Hatta remained second from bottom with one point.
